data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 vs Sunseeker Predator 55 for your Marbella yacht charter comes down to speed, space, and style. Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they cater to different kinds of days on the water. The Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) is a sporty open-cockpit cruiser that hits 40 knots, while the Predator 55 (17.5m, 12 pax) offers more deck space and a flybridge for lounging. Here's how they stack up for your next Marbella charter.

Pershing 46 vs Sunseeker Predator 55: Quick Comparison

FeaturePershing 46Sunseeker Predator 55

Speed & Performance: Pershing 46 Takes the Lead

The Pershing 46 is built for speed. With twin diesel engines pushing it to around 40 knots, it's one of the fastest options in our fleet for a quick blast along the Marbella coast. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is no slouch at 36 knots, but its larger hull and extra weight make it more of a comfortable cruiser than a pure sports boat. If you want to feel the wind in your hair on a 2-hour sunset run to Cala del Faro, the Pershing 46 is your pick.

Capacity & Comfort: Predator 55 Wins for Groups

With 12 passengers max, the Sunseeker Predator 55 offers more deck space, a flybridge, and a larger cabin area. It's better for groups who want to spread out, sunbathe, or host a small party. The Pershing 46 maxes out at 10 guests and has a more compact cockpit layout. For a romantic couple or a group of four, the Pershing 46 feels intimate. For a family reunion or corporate outing, the Predator 55 gives you room to move.

Price & Value: Pershing 46 Has Fixed Rates

The Pershing 46 comes with transparent pricing: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is priced on request — you'll need to contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote. If you want instant booking and a fixed budget, the Pershing 46 is straightforward. If you're flexible and want a larger vessel, the Predator 55 can be arranged.

Best Itineraries for Each Yacht

From Boat Rental Marbella, both yachts depart Puerto Banús. For the Pershing 46, a 2-hour sunset cruise to Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro is ideal — you can cover the 5 NM in 15 minutes and enjoy the views. For a half-day trip, head south to Estepona (10 NM) or east to Cabopino. The Sunseeker Predator 55 is better for full-day charters to Sotogrande (25 NM) or a leisurely loop around the Golden Mile with stops for swimming.

Which Should You Choose?

  • Choose the Pershing 46 if you want speed, a sporty feel, fixed pricing, and a smaller group (up to 10). Perfect for a 2-hour sunset run or a quick day trip.
  • Choose the Sunseeker Predator 55 if you need space for 12 guests, a flybridge, and a more luxurious cruising experience. Best for full-day charters and parties.

Both yachts include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. No hidden costs. For the Pershing 46, you can book directly. For the Predator 55, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.
